deploy_steps: 1. Run D1 database migrations for production: `pnpm --filter public-api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote`
2. Cloudflare Pages CI will automatically deploy the frontend changes if pushed to main.
3. Trigger Workers deployment for public-api: `pnpm --filter public-api exec wrangler deploy`
4. Trigger Workers deployment for admin-api: `pnpm --filter admin-api exec wrangler deploy`
smoke_tests: Submit a valid guest checkout payload to the production checkout endpoint and verify 200 OK + Stripe URL.
Submit an invalid payload (e.g. missing UUID) and verify 400 Bad Request.
Ensure Admin UI login still successfully routes to the admin CRM data.

handoff.devops_ci_notes: No new secrets needed. The `db:migrate` command in the CI or manual instructions has been updated to use wrangler directly on the `public-api`.
handoff.residual_risks: Index creation on D1 locks the table momentarily. If traffic is exceptionally high during migration, some API requests might time out. Recommended to deploy during off-peak hours.
